findings: The required pre-author command cannot reach the review/root gate over the exact frozen manifest, so the prescribed reviewer-to-author sequence is not executable.
The boundary, author, benchmark, and owner-law artifacts consistently retain zero credit before later unanimous selection and integration gates.
The manifest/validator shape contradiction and later self-referential candidate-root digest prevent the frozen boundary from admitting the documented evidence objects.
The public operation is precisely bound to CSS Syntax section 4.3.13, maximal guarded fraction/exponent consumption, binary64 conversion, offset behavior, and retained positive/negative cases.
The contract and harness require the exact ordinary three-property value/type/sign leaf, Object.is value comparison, negative zero, and no surplus keys, symbols, or accessors.

The feature row says every public failure is exercised against all seven predecessor classes, but assertRawCase selects only predecessors[caseIndex % predecessors.length] and loops only over diagnostic mode and state profile.

The controls call their values sizes_utf16_code_units, but materializeHostile treats each size as a digit count; fraction, exponent, and incomplete-exponent source constructions therefore exceed the documented exact 4096/8192/16384/32768 code-unit sizes.
Public fixtures cover malformed starts, non-ASCII input, offsets, guarded dot/exponent boundaries, long prefixes, and four hostile construction families.
The public harness composes the leaf in number, integer-guard, percentage, and dimension contexts while keeping suffix dispatch outside this row.
Self-check and recorded negative controls pass, but the exact real pre-author command exits 1 with 'manifest holdout receipt keys mismatch: bytes,path,sha256' before reading either challenge.

Public receipt validation binds the exact formation/closure, ciphertext identity, canonical base64 envelope, AES-256-GCM metadata, coverage categories, anti-duplication facts, and absence/freshness attestations without exposing plaintext or key material.

The H authority exactly matches Git commit 9fce504a5764258c8e56b0ce77cd656c725a4907, blob cbb57ab5327bc0afa667fbd13ad98d77f3b610de, and the 92-byte LF-terminated production line hash; B/S/D inputs are identity-bound and the H/B non-independence is disclosed.

The H/B/S/D target constructions are intelligible, lineage-specific uses of parse-that (historical regex, BBNF any/all, spec-clause terminals, and native dispatch), but assertTopology does not reject MethodDeclaration nodes and accepts allowed method names on unproven receivers, leaving a reachable inline-object helper/indirection bypass.

The statistical recomputation and exact seven peer keys are coherent, but validateManifest merely shape-checks candidate/build/correctness/pre-author hashes and never resolves them to exact evidence bytes; its own passing synthetic manifest uses invented repeated-character hashes. The ledger is also first-created mode 0444, so a later distinct attempt cannot normally append.
The public protocol reserves selection for five pairwise-distinct skeptics and three further unanimous adjudicators over an already reviewed unblocked candidate hash.

evidence: manifest.json is exactly 878 bytes with SHA-256 4a1b7096fb48a69240b66a2b9a4fb42a1707f71b5d0e0af0dcf50d8bf6c43422.
author-admission-validator.mjs --self-check reports 34 precursor rows, closure 8064807b6d594530c24c65c053a36c7a7ccd16e17a7d5f9b68966a264b76db73, eight topology negative controls, and seven schemas.
author-admission-validator.mjs --negative-controls reports PASS, yet --pre-author over the exact manifest exits before challenge loading with the path-bearing holdout row key mismatch.

author-admission-validator.mjs lines 106-115 define identityRow as an exact sha256/bytes object; lines 720-723 pass manifest.holdout_receipt and manifest.holdout_ciphertext, each frozen with path/sha256/bytes, to that exact-key check.

author-admission-validator.mjs lines 595-605 hash every file below each seat root, while lines 766-769 read author-receipt.json from that root and require its candidate.isolated_root_sha256 to equal that whole-tree hash.
harness.ts lines 143-180 select one predecessor per case; the only nested loops are diagnostics modes and profiles, contradicting feature-row.json failure_contract.public_test.
benchmark-validator.mjs --self-check passes recomputation, but lines 46-84 never read the evidence named by the manifest hashes and lines 222-250 demonstrate acceptance using synthetic hash strings.

defects.summary: The exact documented pre-author command rejects the exact frozen manifest before reaching the expected review stage.
evidence: From the mirror root, `node cells/syntax-consume-number/g7/author-admission-validator.mjs --pre-author cells/syntax-consume-number/g7/manifest.json` exits 1 with `manifest holdout receipt keys mismatch: bytes,path,sha256`.
manifest.json requires path-bearing holdout_receipt and holdout_ciphertext rows, but sameIdentity calls identityRow, whose exactKeys permits only sha256 and bytes.
defects.required_repair: Make preAuthor validate each frozen path separately and compare only its sha256/bytes identity fields (or define and consistently use one path-bearing row validator), add a real-manifest negative/positive control proving execution reaches the missing-review gate, then reform and reseal because the validator is inside the precursor closure.

defects.summary: The four-seat candidate-root identity requires a SHA-256 fixed point over the receipt that contains that identity.
evidence: fourSeat reads <seat>/author-receipt.json and then compares author.candidate.isolated_root_sha256 with treeIdentity(seatRoot).
treeIdentity recursively hashes every file in seatRoot, including author-receipt.json itself, so changing isolated_root_sha256 changes the digest it must equal.
defects.required_repair: Define a non-self-referential candidate payload closure (for example, hash an exact allowed payload file set that excludes the detached author receipt), verify candidate.source_path equals the canonical seat path, and add an executable four-seat fixture proving one ordinary receipt can satisfy the identity gate.

defects.summary: The mechanical topology gate does not enforce the documented no-local-function/direct-construction floor.
evidence: assertTopology rejects FunctionExpression and ClassExpression but not an object-literal MethodDeclaration nested in the export initializer.

Property calls are accepted solely by method-name membership; the receiver is not proven to be a parser combinator or an inline mapper parameter. The author receipt API list is not compared with the AST counts.
defects.required_repair: Reject every function-like/helper node except narrowly validated inline mapper arrows, reject statement-bearing method bodies and loops, prove allowed call receivers arise from the direct combinator graph or mapper parameters, compare receipt API declarations with observed topology, and add bypass-specific negative controls before reforming the closure.

defects.summary: Executable public coverage is weaker than the frozen diagnostics and exact-size limit claims.
evidence: assertRawCase chooses one predecessor using caseIndex modulo seven; it does not run each public failure against all seven predecessor classes as feature-row.json states.
materializeHostile adds syntax around count digits, so non-digit constructions are not the exact UTF-16 code-unit sizes named by g7-controls.json and feature-row.json.
defects.required_repair: Nest every public failure across all seven predecessor values and update assertion accounting; construct each hostile source/consumed representation to the exact declared UTF-16 lengths, assert those lengths in validatePublicFixtures/runWorkLimitHarness, and reform the frozen precursor.

defects.summary: The benchmark validator can certify a receipt whose source, build, correctness, and admission hashes do not identify any supplied evidence.
evidence: validateManifest checks hash syntax and distinctness but never reads or compares pre-author receipts, candidate sources, author receipts, build manifests, bundles, correctness receipts, corpora, normalized observations, or the runner bytes.

The self-check's synthetic manifest uses repeated-character placeholder hashes and passes. appendLedger creates ledger.jsonl with mode 0444, which prevents a normal later invocation from appending a distinct attempt despite the multi-attempt contract.
defects.required_repair: Require an evidence-root closure, resolve every identity-bearing manifest field to exact immutable bytes before timing/receipt validation, cross-check admitted sources and correctness observations, and add a two-distinct-attempt self-check using an append design that retains and verifies both rows without retry erasure.
